name: Antitoxin (vial)
description: A prepared antitoxin vial used to resist or reduce poison effects for a short period.
narrative_effects: Supports resistance or reduction of poison effects for roughly an hour.

mechanical_effect.trigger: consumed or administered before or shortly after poison exposure; active for roughly an hour
mechanical_effect.applies_to: checks to resist, reduce, or recover from poison effects during the antitoxin's effective period
mechanical_effect.does_not_apply: disease, curses, non-poison toxins outside its scope, or poison effects already resolved beyond treatment
